events.title: Trade Single Window routine Sunday maintenance
events.summary: New Zealand Customs publishes a routine TSW maintenance window every Sunday from 02:00 to 04:00 local time.
events.operational_impact: TSW may be unavailable during the routine maintenance period.
events.workaround: Plan time-sensitive lodgements outside the Sunday maintenance window.
events.source_name: New Zealand Customs Service — Current TSW status

events.title: Trade Single Window scheduled maintenance
events.summary: New Zealand Customs has scheduled TSW maintenance from 02:00 to 06:00 local time on 14 September. No outage is anticipated, but lodgement responses may be delayed.
events.operational_impact: Lodgement responses may be delayed during the published window.
events.workaround: Plan time-sensitive lodgements around the maintenance period.
events.source_name: New Zealand Customs Service — Current TSW status

events.title: DELTA IE active technical anomalies
events.summary: French Customs currently lists DELTA IE import technical anomalies as still under treatment.
events.operational_impact: Some import declarations or release-related messages may require workarounds documented by French Customs.
events.workaround: Consult the official anomaly journal for the affected declaration flow and prescribed workaround.
events.source_name: Direction générale des douanes — DELTA IE import anomaly journal
